(nya)༄༅/ /'byung ba lnga'i tsha tsha bskrun pa'i mchod sbyin la brten pa'i 'chi bslu'i cho ga grub pa'i zhal lung 'dab brgya 'grol byed ces bya ba bzhugs/

tei:div.tei:p: (nya)༄༅// 'byung ba lnga'i tsha tsha bskrun pa'i mchod sbyin la brten pa'i 'chi bslu'i cho ga grub pa'i zhal lung 'dab brgya 'grol byed ces bya ba bzhugs// 'khor lo'i mgon po bla ma dang*// gnyis min 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed// gus pas phyag 'tshal 'byung lnga yi// rang gzugs sātstsha'i 'chi bslu 'dri// de'ang nad pa la sogs pa'i don du 'byung lnga'i sātstsha 'debs pa'i lag len la/ sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ rjes gsum las/ dang po ni stegs kyi khar yi dam la zlum gtor rgyan ldan dang chu gnyis nyer spyod sgreng tshar du bkod pa dang*/ sngon 'gro gzhi bdag dkar gtor/ lan chags bgegs kyi gtor ma rnams dkar mngar sogs zas sna ci 'byor pas brgyan pa bsham/ de'i mdun phyogs su sa stegs la sogs par maṇḍal che chung ji ltar rigs pa la thig chen brgyad btab pas gru bzhi pa shar sngo lho ser nub dmar byang ljang dbus dkar bar byas pa'i gzhi la/ kham sa gtsang ma las srung ba'i tsha tsha lnga rten 'brel snying po dang oṃ hūm̐ trāṃ hrīḥ.aḥzhes bzla zhing byin gyis brlabs te btab pa dang*/ yang kham sa la nad pa'i skra sen lus drud bsres pa'i tsha tsha brgya rtsa'am lo grangs sam ma 'byor na lnga rang rang gi phyogs mdog byas pa rnams/ dbus dang phyogs bzhir tshon gyi kha dog dang mthun par dgram/ de dag gi grangs dang mnyam pa'i mar me/ lha bshos ngar glud chang bu sha dum zas sna rnams kyang bsham mo// gnyis pa ni/ yi dam rdo rje 'jigs byed sogs gang la byas kyang rung ste/ de'i bsgom bzlas gtor ma 'bul ba bcas bya'o// 'dir gshin rje tshe bdag la byed pa'i dbang du btang na/ sngon 'gro gtor ma dang bgegs gtor bsngos la drag sngags rol mo dang bcas pas mtshams bcad/ mchod gtor byin gyis brlabs pa dang*/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed rnams spyi ltar sngon du 'gro bas/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs kyis stong par sbyangs/

stong pa'i ngang las rang nyid gshin rje tshe bdag bskyed pa dang*/ ye shes pa spyan drangs pa la sman mchod rakta/ gtor 'bul/ mchod bstod/ bsrung bzlog gi bsgom bzlas gzhung ltar nyams su blang ngo*// de nas thog mar tsha tsha rab tu gnas pa'i phyir/ tsha tsha la lha sngags zlos shing yungs kar gyis brab ste bgegs bskrad/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs sngags dang bcas pas khrus byas la/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs kyis tsha tsha rnams stong par sbyangs/ chos kun stong pa'i ngang nyid las// seng khri padma zla ba'i steng*// oṃ las 'khor lo oṃ gyis mtshan// de las rnam par snang mdzad dkar// byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya can// sna tshogs dar dang rin chen brgyan// zhabs gnyis rdo rje skyil krung bzhugs// de nyid yongs su gyur pa las// chos sku'i mchod rten mtshan nyid rdzogs// mchod rten rnams kyi bum pa'i nang*// dbus su seng ge shar glang chen// lhor rta nub tu rma bya dang*// byang du mkha' lding bteg pa'i khrir// padma zla ba'i 'dab lnga la// dbus su oṃ las rnam snang dkar// byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya can// shar du hūm̐ las mi bskyod pa// sngon po sa gnon mnyam gzhag can// lho ru trāṃ las rin 'byung ser// mchog sbyin mnyam gzhag phyag rgya mdzad// nub tu hrīḥlas 'od dpag med// dmar po phyag gnyis mnyam gzhag can// byang du aḥlas don yod grub// ljang gu skyabs sbyin mnyam gzhag can// kun kyang dar dang rin chen brgyan// zhabs gnyis rdo rje'i skyil krung bzhugs// kun gyi mtha' skor sangs rgyas dang*// sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor bar gyur// kun gyi gnas gsum oṃ āḥhūm̐/ hūm̐ las 'od 'phros rigs lnga la// rgyal ba sras bcas kyis bskor ba// tshur byon badzra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs dbyer med thim// bum nang lha tshogs thams cad kyi// dpral bar oṃ las 'khor lor oṃ// mgrin par āḥlas padmar āḥ

thugs kar hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐// slar yang 'od 'phros dbang gi lha// rigs lnga 'khor bcas sa mā dzaḥ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis// 'di rnams dbang bskur stsol gsol bas// ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yis// de bzhin bdag gis dbang bskur ro// oṃ de bzhin gshegs kun dbang bskur dus// dpal gyi don du hūm̐ zhes gsungs// dbang bskur dri ma dag byas chu// yar lud rigs lngas spyi bor brgyan// rdo rjes spyan dbye tshul dang*/ kun mkhyen ye shes spyan dag kyang*// gus pas 'phags pa'i spyan dbye bas// nam mkha' mnyam pa'i sems can rnams// sangs rgyas ye shes spyan thob shog /oṃ tsakṣu tsakṣu sa manta tsakṣu bi sho dha ne swā hā/ ye shes spyan ni rnam dag nyid// thob nas sems can don byed la// 'jug pa'i mthu dang ldan gyur cig /ces brjod/ mchod bstod bya ba ni/ rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad la// mchod yon zhabs bsil me tog spos// mar me dri bshos rol mos mchod// bzhes nas sems can don mdzad gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badzra arghaṃ puṣpe dhū pe ā lo ke gandhe nai wi dya shapta āḥhūm̐/ rol mo dang*/ chos sku mkha' bzhin dbyer med kyang*// gzugs sku 'ja' ltar so sor gsal// thabs dang shes rab mchog brnyes pa'i// rigs lnga bder gshegs la phyag 'tshal// mchod rten lha dang bcas zhu ba// tsha tsha'i rnam pa ji bzhin gyur// de nas ye dharmā bzlas pa'i nas thogs te/ brtan bzhugs bya ba ni/ hūm̐ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro 'khor dang bcas// rigs lnga yum bzhi sems dpa' lha mo dang*// khro tshogs bcas pa bdag la dgongs su gsol// 'gro rnams snying po byang chub ma thob bar// mya ngan mi 'da' brtan par bzhugs su gsol// chos sku'i rang bzhin rten mchog 'di rnams la// ji srid 'byung bzhi'i gnod pas ma zhig bar// tshad med thugs rje phrin las rgya chen gyis// 'gro don mdzad cing brtan par bzhugs su gsol// oṃ su pra tiṣṭha badzrā ya swā hā/

ye dharmā he tu pra bhā wa sogs brjod/ de lta bu lan gsum du brtan bzhugs byas la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badzra arghaṃ sogs nas shabda āḥhūm̐ bar gyis mchod/ sna tshogs padma zla ba'i gdan steng du// sna tshogs rin chen khams las grub pa yi// sprul pa'i mchod rten sna tshogs rgyan gyis brgyan// chos sku'i rang bzhin can la phyag 'tshal lo// bkra shis kyi mnga' gsol ba ni/ ston mchog dam pa'am che ba'i che mchog gang rung zhig gi bkra shis brjod do// de dag ni sātstsha'i rab gnas so// de nas mchod sbyin stob pa'i yul du gyur pa spyan 'dren cing dgug pa ni/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga la sogs pa phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'/ nyan thos rang sangs rgyas la sogs pa mchod yul 'phags pa'i tshogs dang*/ 'byung ba bzhi la dbang ba'i 'khor 'das kyi mgron rigs/ snang zhing srid pa'i lha srin sde brgyad phan gnod las kyi 'brel thogs mchod sbyin gyi yul du gyur pa thams cad skad cig nyid la 'dir gshegs shig hūm̐ phyi nang 'byung lnga'i rang bzhin nyid// rnam dag rigs lnga gtso 'khor ni// rdo rje rin chen padma dang*// ral gri 'khor lo'i rigs can gyi// sa chu me rlung nam mkha'i lha// gdod nas chos dbyings dag pa'i ngang*// khams gsum snod bcud sbyang ba'i phyir// thugs rten 'di la spyan 'dren gshegs// snang srid lha srin sde brgyad dang*// nad yams 'byung ba dgra gshed bdag /lan chags grib bdag pho mo'i tshogs// thab gzhob 'khon gyi bdag po rnams// lan chags sha 'khon sbyang phyir dang*// rgyu dang rkyen las gyur pa yi// gnod par byed pa gang yang rung*// 'byung lnga'i tsha tshas sbyang phyir gshegs// oṃ lo kotta ra lo ka pā la sa pa ri wā ra sa mā dzaḥ bzhugs su gsol ba ni/ 'jig rten 'das dang ma 'das pa'i// mchod sbyin mgron du gnyer byas pa// thams cad sbyin pa'i bdag po yi// rkyen ngan bar chad bsal phyir bzhugs// sa ma ya tiṣṭhantu/

khrus gsol ni/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yis// de bzhin bdag gis sku khrus gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ sku phyi ba ni/ de dag sku la mtshungs pa med pa'i gos// gtsang la dri rab bsgos pas sku phyi'o// oṃ hūm̐ trāṃ hrīḥ.aḥkā ya bi sho dha ni swā hā/ gos 'bul ba ni/ srab 'jam yang mdzes lha yi gos// kha dog lnga ldan zung sbyar 'di// 'byung lnga dbang sgyur sku la gsol// 'byung lnga 'jig med lus thob shog /oṃ lo kotta ra lo ka pā la sa pa ri wā ra wast+rā ya āḥhūm̐/ bshos dang mar me 'bul ba ni// 'chi med bcud len lha yi bshos// phyogs kun snang byed mar me'i mdangs// 'byung lnga'i mnga' bdag rnams la 'bul// 'byung lnga gsal 'tsher sku thob shog /oṃ lo kotta ra lo ka pā la sa pa ri wā ra nai wi dya ā lo ke āḥhūm̐/ bstod pa ni/ hūm̐ snang stong rdo rje nam mkha'i dbyings// chos dbyings ye shes rdo rje'i sku// byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya can// phyag 'tshal rnam par snang mdzad la// gzung 'dzin rdo rje brtan pa'i sa// me long ye shes rdo rje'i sku// bdud 'dul chen po'i phyag rgya can// phyag 'tshal mi bskyod rdo rje la// rin chen rdo rje 'bar ba'i me// mnyam nyid ye shes rdo rje'i sku// mchog sbyin chen po'i phyag rgya can// phyag 'tshal rin chen 'byung ldan la// 'dod chags rdo rje chos kyi chu// sor rtog ye shes rdo rje'i sku// ting 'dzin chen po'i phyag rgya can// phyag 'tshal 'od dpag med mgon la// phrag dog rdo rje bskyod pa'i rlung*// bya grub ye shes rdo rje'i sku// skyabs sbyin chen po'i phyag rgya can// phyag 'tshal don yod grub pa la'o// phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba rgyal ba'i sras// chos skyong ba dang 'jig rten skyong*// 'byung ba lnga la dbang sgyur lha// phyag byar 'os pa kun la bstod// bdag cag yon bdag 'khor bcas la// phyi nang 'byung ba 'khrugs gyur pa'i// nad gdon nyer 'tshe dus min 'chi// thams cad bzlog bsgyur phrin las mdzod// bshags pa ni/

hūm̐ dug lnga ye shes lngar dag nas// 'gro ba'i dug lnga sbyong mdzad pa'i// yon tan ma rtogs kun rtog gi /yul du zhen pa bzod par gsol// phan byed 'byung ba'i lha tshogs la// gnod pa'i dgra 'drer bzung nas ni// brdeg brdung 'khon gyi las bsags pa'i// nyes pa gang lags bzod par rigs// zhes so// de nas rang nyid lha'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas gyer bsgom lhan cig pas 'di skad do// hūm̐ nga ni 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed// nga ni 'jam dpal las kyi lha// nga ni tshe bdag khro bo'i rje// nga yis mi 'dul gang yang med// gto yis mi bzlog gcig kyang med// 'byung ba'i 'khrugs 'dre gto yis bsgyur// spar kha'i yo 'khrugs gto yis bcos// rkyen ngan bar chad gto yis bsgyur// de phyir yon gyi bdag po la// 'byung ba 'khrugs 'dre'i nad langs pa// bdag cag rnal 'byor sgrub pa pos// rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas thugs kyi rten// 'byung lnga'i tsha tsha bzhengs nas kyang*// rgyal kun zhing khams rab 'byams dngos// byin rlabs dbang bskur rab gnas pas// lha mi'i bsod nams rten mchog bzhengs// deng dus sbyin bdag lus rten gyi// 'byung ba 'khrugs 'dre zhi ba dang*// 'byung lnga phan tshun stobs mnyam phyir// 'byung ba lnga yi tsha tsha bzhengs// rnam shes sgron ma rab gsal zhing*// 'byung ba lnga mdangs 'tsher ba'i phyir// ting 'dzin sngags kyis byin brlabs pa'i// snang gsal mar me'i phreng ba spar// 'byung tshogs 'dus pa'i lus rten 'di// nad med ring du srog 'tsho phyir// ro bcud phun tshogs lha bshos bstar// hūm̐ nga ni khro rgyal gshin rje'i gshed// zhal gsum mthing dkar dmar ba

'jigs byed la yi dam byed pa'i tshe/ mthing nag zhal gcig ma he'i zhal// phyag gnyis gri gug thod pa can/ can// phyag drug mtshon chas nad gdon 'dul// dur khrod chas brgyan cha lugs kyis// khams gsum dregs pa bsngangs shing 'dar// zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum gnod ma he'i steng*/ byed ma he'i steng*/ mnan/ gshin rje'i gshed dpal stobs po che// zhes bsgyur/ gzhan la'ang des 'gre'o/ /tshe bdag gshin rje stobs po che// nga yis mi bzlog gang yang med// de ring rgyu sbyor yon bdag la// shar phyogs spar kha 'khrugs lang pa'i// na shi'i rkyen sgo bye gyur na// 'byung ba shing gi tsha tshas bsgyur// de ring rgyu sbyor yon bdag la// lho phyogs spar kha 'khrugs lang ba'i// na sha'i rkyen sgo bye gyur na// 'byung ba me yi tsha tshas bsgyur// de ring rgyu sbyor yon bdag la// nub phyogs spar kha 'khrugs lang ba'i// na shi'i rkyen sgo bye gyur na// 'byung ba lcags kyi tsha tshas bsgyur// de ring rgyu sbyor yon bdag la// byang phyogs spar kha 'khrugs lang ba'i// na shi'i rkyen sgo bye gyur na// 'byung ba chu yi tsha tshas bsgyur// de ring rgyu sbyor yon bdag la// dbus phyogs sa bdag 'khrugs lang ba'i// na shi'i rkyen sgo bye gyur na// 'byung ba sa yi tsha tshas bsgyur// shar lho nub byang dbus lnga nas// 'byung lnga'i tsha tsha da bzhud la// nad gdon grib kyi kha khog cig /dri za gshin rje klu yi gdon// ma mo 'byung po'i kha khog cig /de ring rgyu sbyor sbyin bdag gi /rkyen ngan bar chad da sgyur cig /keg dang sri langs da bzlog cig /byad gtad rbod gtong phyir bzlog cig /ltas ngan ye 'drog da sgyur cig /na sgo 'chi sgo da sdoms shig /nad dang gdon bgegs 'tshe ba rnams// bzlog bsgyur phrin las grub par mdzod// ces brjod do// de nas nad pa sogs khrus bya ba'i phyir/

rgyas pa na bum pa'i nang du khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil pa bskyed bzlas bya/ mi nus na bum pa'i chu la dmigs te/ oṃ badzra a mṛ ta kuṇḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa brgya rtsa gcig bzlas la/ chu des nad pa'i gdong la sogs pa bkru zhing*/ oṃ badzra a mṛ ta sogs sngags dang*/ sbyin pa'i bdag po'i tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ nad thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ de bzhin du gdon thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ rims thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ nye bar 'tshe ba thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ dus ma yin par 'chi ba thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ 'khon dang grib dang mi gtsang ba thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ byad dang byur dang skal ba ngan pa thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ bkra mi shis pa thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ mtshan mo nag mo dang dus kyi zhags pa dang gshin rje'i pho nya thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ bgegs dang log par 'dren pa thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ rgyal po dang the'u rang gi gnod pa thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ klu dang sa bdag gi gnod pa thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ btsan dang dmu'i gnod pa thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes pas bkrus pa'i chu snod du bsags/ slar yang nad pa'i khar chu bzung du bcug la/ rdo rje dang rma bya'i mdongs lhan cig pas byab pa'i tshul bya zhing*/ a mṛ ta dang*/ gong gi tshig de rnams kyi shāntiṃ gi tshab tu/ a pa na ya swā hā/ zhes btags pa tshar gcig gis byabs te kha'i chu khrus chu nang du dor ro// de nas khrus chu de phyogs bzhi'i glud kyi steng du blugs/ glud gos dang chang bu lo grangs/ sha dum dang gzhan yang kha zas ci 'byor pa spungs pa rnams la chu gtsang gis bran la/ slar yang sngar ma khugs pa'i rigs yod na bden pa'i stobs kyis dgug pa ni/

na mo rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ chos kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ dge 'dun gyi bka' bden pa dang*/ 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed kyi lha tshogs rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang bden pa chen po'i byin gyis brlabs kyis/ 'jig rten gyi khams na gnas pa'i grib 'dre 'chi bdag glud bdag spyi dang*/ bye brag tu sbyin pa'i bdag po che ge mo'i lus ngag yid gsum la gnod cing sha 'khon du gyur pa/ nad bdag 'chi bdag glud kyi bdag po thams cad/ 'chi bslu srog glud len pa'i phyir/ skad cig thang gcig yud tsam la 'dir mchis par gyur cig ā karṣa ya dzaḥ zhes pas bkug hūm̐ bla ma yi dam lha tshogs dang*// phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas dang*// bka' srung dam can srung ma'i tshogs// sprin ltar gtibs pa'i 'og rol du// srid gsum gnas pa'i grib 'dre dang*// bye brag bdag dang sbyin bdag la// gnod cing sha 'khon gnyer byed pa'i// nad bdag glud bdag ma lus pa// sbyin bdag yon mchod 'khor bcas kyi// 'chi bslu srog glud len phyir du// dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa'i mthus// 'dir 'dus dga' ba'i sems kyis 'khod// ces brjod do// de nas mdun gyi glud rdzas rnams la dmigs nas/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs kyis sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rgyu rdzas rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i glud dang 'dod pa'i yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pa so so'i 'dod pa'i re ba thams cad yid bzhin du bskang ba'i nus pa phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan par gyur par bsams la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum dang*/ lag pa mchog sbyin dang bcas te/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te oṃ sambha ra sambha ra hūm̐/ lan nyer gcig gis bsngos la/ hūm̐ bdag gi bsam pa'i stobs dang ni// de bzhin gshegs pa'i sbyin stobs dang*// chos kyi dbyings kyi stobs rnams kyis// lan chags mgron la gang byin pa// don rnams gang dag bsams pa kun// 'jig rten khams 'di ma lus pa// de dag thams cad ci rigs pa// thogs pa med par 'byung gyur cig

/hūm̐ srid gsum gnas pa'i grib 'dre dang*// bye brag deng gi sbyin bdag la// gnod cing sha 'khon gnyer byed pa'i// nad bdag glud bdag ma lus dang*// 'byung ba'i lo bdud thams cad la// 'byung lnga glud kyi ngar mi 'di// zhal bzang spyan bzang gos kyang bzang*// chang bu sha rjen bza' ba sogs// 'dod yon longs spyod ri ltar spungs// ting 'dzin sngags kyis rgya cher spel// deng 'dir che ge mo zhes pa'i/ tshe dang srog gi glud du 'bul// glud 'di longs la tshe srog byin// bzung ba thong la bcings pa khrol// phyin chad gnod pa ma byed cig /'chi ba'i srog la kun kyang bsrung*// 'tsho ba'i zas la kun kyang 'du// rang gi lus la dpe longs la// gzhan la gnod pa ma byed cig /oṃ chen po'am chung ngu gang dag gis// lus la mngon par gnod gyur pa'i// nad de nye bar phyung nas ni// gdon rnams rang gi gnas su dengs// de ltar bdag gis ci nus kyis// mchod dang bsnyen bkur byas pa yi// dam tshig gnas la gnas nas su// bdag gi bsam pa skong bar mdzod// 'dir ni bdag cag sbyin bdag gi /nad de rab tu sol mdzod la// gdon rnams rang gi gnas su song*// sarba bighnān gatstsha/ zhes dang*/ a kro ta sogs yi dam gang yin gyi drag sngags brjod do// glud rdzas dang bcas pa lo bdud yod pa'i phyogs sam chu bor bskyal lo// de nas bsrung ba'i tsha tsha lnga po ma gtogs pa phyogs bzhi'i tsha tsha rnams shar nas rim bzhin khang steng la sogs pa'i phyogs phyogs su tshigs bcad re rdzogs pa dang 'bul du bcug ste/ de'ang*/ hūm̐ 'byung ba mchod rten chen po 'di// rdo rje sems dpa'i lha tshogs la// 'bul lo bdag dang yon bdag gi /zhe sdang nad rnams zhi ba dang*// shar phyogs shing khams ma 'khrugs shig /tsha tsha rnams shar phyogs su 'bul/ de bzhin du/ hūm̐ rin chen spungs pa'i mchod rten 'di// rin chen 'byung ldan lha tshogs la// 'bul lo bdag dang yon bdag gi

/nga rgyal nad rnams zhi ba dang*// lho phyogs me khams ma 'khrugs shig /hūm̐ padma spungs pa'i mchod rten 'di// snang ba mtha' yas lha tshogs la// 'bul lo bdag dang yon bdag gi /'dod chags nad rnams zhi ba dang*// nub phyogs lcags khams ma 'khrugs shig /hūm̐ 'bras bu spungs pa'i mchod rten 'di// don yod grub pa'i lha tshogs la// 'bul lo bdag dang yon bdag gi /phrag don nad rnams zhi ba dang*// byang phyogs chu khams ma 'khrugs shig /hūm̐ chos kyi 'khor lo'i mchod rten 'di// rnam par snang mdzad lha tshogs la// 'bul lo bdag dang yon bdag gi /gti mug nad rnams zhi ba dang*// dbus phyogs sa khams ma 'khrugs shig /ces pas 'bul/ srung ba'i tsha tsha rnams dbus nas rim par sbyin bdag gi spyi bo// mgrin pa/ snying ga lte ba/ gsang ba rnams su reg pa dang bstun la/ hūm̐ spyi bo bde chen 'khor lo la// rnam par snang mdzad lha tshogs kyis// bsrung zhing 'chi med dngos grub stsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta bai ro tsa na kā ya rakṣantu/ ā yuḥsiddhi dzaḥ hūm̐ mgrin pa longs spyod 'khor lo la// snang ba mtha' yas lha tshogs kyis// bsrung zhing 'chi med dngos grub stsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a mi tā bha wāka rakṣantu/ ā yuḥsiddhi dzaḥ hūm̐ snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo la// rdo rje sems dpa'i lha tshogs kyis// bsrung zhing 'chi med dngos grub stsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badzra satwa tsitta rakṣantu/ ā yuḥsiddhi dzaḥ hūm̐ lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo la// rin chen 'byung ldan lha tshogs kyis// bsrung zhing 'chi med dngos grub stsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ratna saṃ bha wa na bhi rakṣantu/ ā yuḥsiddhi dzaḥ hūm̐ gsang gnas bde skyong 'khor lo la// don yod grub pa'i lha tshogs kyis// bsrung zhing 'chi med dngos grub stsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a mo gha siddhiḥgu hya rakṣantu/

ā yuḥsiddhi dzaḥ zhes pas gnas lngar bsrung*/ slar yang rdo rje'i bsrung ba ni/ sbyin bdag gi spyi bo dang mdun rgyab gnyis dang*/ dpung pa gnyis/ pus mo gnyis rnams su rdo rje rgya gram gyis reg pa dang bcas te/ gong gi khrus kyi skabs ltar a mṛ te'i sngags dang*/ sbyin pa'i bdag pos tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad rakṣa rakṣaḥ sogs nas btsan dang dmu'i gnod pa thams cad rakṣa rakṣaḥ zhes dang*/ rigs lnga bde gshegs tshe yi bdag /rgyu sbyor yon gyi bdag po 'dir// tshe yi mu thag brkyang du gsol// lus la rdo rje'i go cha bgos// mgo la rdo rje'i dbu rmog bgos// steng du 'khor lo'i gur khang phub// 'og tu padma'i thang ma brdal// logs su rin chen ral gri'i tshogs// mtshon cha 'bar ba'i gur khang bskor// cis kyang mi shigs mi tshugs pa'i// bsrung ba bla na med pa yis// sbyin bdag 'di la bsrung du gsol// zhes pas bsrung*/ shis pa brjod pa'i phyir me tog gtor zhing*/ che ba'i che mchog sogs dang*/ mi 'gyur lhun po sogs dang*/ bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu zhi ba sogs dang*/ bsod nams ri bo bzhin du sogs dang*/ lo brgya thub cing sogs dang*/ tshangs dang lha dbang sogs dang*/ nyin mor bde legs sogs kyi mthar/ sbyin pa'i bdag pos gtsor byas pa'i skye dgu thams cad spang bya mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal nas bkra shis par gyur cig dza ya dza ya bi dza yantu/ zhes brjod de/ nad pa'am sbyin bdag rang gnas su gtang ngo*// gsum pa rjes ni/ sngar spyan drangs pa'i 'jig rten las 'das pa dang 'jig rten pa thams cad la mchod par bsams la/ oṃ lo kotta ra lo ka pā la sa pa ri wā ra oṃ badzra arghaṃ puṣpe dhū pe ā lo ke gandhe nai wi dya shabda pra tītstsha swā hā/ chos sku nam mkha' bzhin du sogs shlau ka gcig dang*/

phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba rgyal ba'i sras// chos skyong ba dang 'jig rten skyong*// 'byung ba lnga la dbang sgyur lha// phyag byar 'os pa kun la bstod// bdag cag yon bdag 'khor bcas la// phyi nang 'byung ba 'khrugs gyur pa'i// nad gdon nyer 'tshe dus min 'chi// thams cad zhi bar mdzad du gsol// zhes dang*/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa sogs kyis bzod par gsol/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can sogs dang*/ oṃ badzra muḥye shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ mchod sbyin gnas 'dir gang lhags pa// 'byung po sa 'og rgyu ba dang*// gang yang sa steng 'khod pa dang*// sa blar rgyu ba gang yin pa// mgu bar gyis la rang gnas su// thams cad tha dad 'gro bar gyis// sarba bhū ta gatstsha/ sarba pre ta gatstsha/ rang gi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ zhes bsam zhing las kyi rjes mi mngon par byas la/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /sbyin pa rnam bzhi'i dga' ston gyi// mgron du 'gro ba kun gnyer zhing*// byang chub lam du bkri bar shog /ces dang*/ bkra shis ci rigs pas mtha' brgyan par bya'o// tsha tsha rnams tsha khang ngam chu bo'i 'gram la sogs pa gang bder bzhugs su gsol lo// 'byung lnga'i tsha tsha bskrun pa'i mchod sbyin gyi// rnal 'byor la brten tshe srog bslu ba'i thabs// grub pa'i zhal lung sbas don mya ngan med// ches gsal mtshar sdug rkang rtses rnam par dkrol// dge bas yid can rnam par grol gyur pa// de srid tshe srog rdo rje ltar brtan pas// byang chub spyod pas sangs rgyas zhing sbyong zhing*// sems can byang chub yongs su smin byed shog /ces 'byung ba lnga'i tsha tsha bskrun pa'i mchod sbyin la brten pa'i 'chi ba bslu ba'i cho ga grub pa'i zhal lung 'dab brgya 'grol byed ces bya ba 'di ni/ zab gsang spyod pa'i gyer bsgom pa sgang mgon gyis bskul ba'i ngor/ slob dpon dga' rab rdo rjes mdzad pa'i gzhung don nyams su blang bde bar/

bande tshul khrims rin chen du bod pas bsdebs pa sems can thams cad la phan thogs par gyur cig/ //sarba maṅga laṃ bha wa tu// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
